name: COMP101_L3_control_structures
authoring_policy: COMP101 control-structures module: dependsOn is strict readiness. usesConcept links carriers (methods/constructs/operators/builtins) or skills to load-bearing concepts. implementedBy is Concept → ConceptCarrier only (asserted); implementsConcept is its owl:inverseOf (ConceptCarrier → Concept; usually inferred, not duplicated in A-Box). Do not put Algorithm on implementedBy — Algorithms employ ConceptCarriers via usesConstruct (inverse constructUsedBy). contrastsWith marks alternatives/opposites/common confusions. acceptsType / operatesOnType / producesType / throwsError are typing and error facts under realistic course conditions.

relation_semantics.dependsOn: Strict prerequisite: understanding the subject requires prior understanding of the object.
relation_semantics.isRequiredBy: Inverse of dependsOn: the object depends on the subject.
relation_semantics.usesConcept: The subject relies on or carries out the object concept in a load-bearing way. Skills in this module may also use usesConcept (OOP/ICS-style).
relation_semantics.isUsedBy: Inverse of usesConcept: this concept is used by the object entity.
relation_semantics.implementedBy: The subject Concept is realized/expressed by the object ConceptCarrier (construct, operator, builtin, or data type). Domain is Concept only (not Algorithm).
relation_semantics.implementsConcept: Inverse of implementedBy: the subject ConceptCarrier realizes the object Concept.
relation_semantics.usesConstruct: Algorithm is coded with / employs this ConceptCarrier (language construct, operator, builtin, or data type). Not an inverse of implementedBy.
relation_semantics.constructUsedBy: Inverse of usesConstruct: this ConceptCarrier is employed by the object Algorithm.
relation_semantics.contrastsWith: Two entities that are alternatives, opposites, or commonly confused and should be distinguished.
relation_semantics.acceptsType: A BuiltInFunction accepts values of this DataType as input under the course model.
relation_semantics.acceptedBy: Inverse of acceptsType: this DataType is accepted as input by the object BuiltInFunction.
relation_semantics.operatesOnType: An Operator works on / applies to this DataType.
relation_semantics.operatedOnBy: Inverse of operatesOnType: this DataType is operated on by the object Operator.
relation_semantics.producesType: The subject operation/function returns this DataType.
relation_semantics.isProducedBy: Inverse of producesType: this DataType is produced by the object.
relation_semantics.throwsError: Performing the subject can, under realistic COMP101 conditions, raise this ErrorType.
relation_semantics.isThrownBy: Inverse of throwsError: this error can be raised by the object.
relation_semantics.methodOf: The subject Method belongs to the object DataType.
relation_semantics.hasMethods: Inverse of methodOf: this DataType declares the object Method.
relation_semantics.taughtIn: First introduction in the named lecture. Graph-only checks cannot verify lecture content.
relation_semantics.teaches: Inverse of taughtIn: this lecture introduces the object entity.
